name: Wolf
role: Hungry wolf of the Valkarr woods
who: a grey timber wolf, lean and rangy, the size of a large dog, with thick grey fur, a darker brown-grey saddle along its back, a pale cream throat and belly, long legs, big paws and pale amber eyes
stow: Its long bushy tail hangs down and a little out behind it, clear of the hind legs, its tip just above the ground. Its ears stand up.
